$comment: The source of sf-form's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js), in the 1.4 form (scripts/generate-component-files.mjs writes rule.js, studio.fixture.json, studio.scenario.json, probe.json and smart.manifest.json from it). A new component, made against standard simai.smart-component 1.3.15 and vocabulary 1.1.5: owner decision C182 (2026-11-14; study control/research/2026-11-14-form.md, prototype prototypes/form-study.html), a form drawn from field descriptions over the Framework's field renderers.

fields.summary: The fields, in order: the Framework field descriptor that sf-view-properties sends -- the property registry's type, its template and its parameters (propertyType, template and templateParams -- variant is the former name of template until 2027-01-01 --, required, readonly, placeholder, options, min, max, step, unit, decimals, currency, currencies, currencyDisplay, holder (a ru.inn field: any, organization -- 10 digits -- or person -- 12), defaultCountry (a phone field: the ISO 3166 alpha-2 country an empty field starts on, else the page's) … as SF.fieldRenderers.registry lists them) plus key, label, hint, help, width and group. width short (the field width step of 20 characters, 160 px at text 16), medium (28, 224 px) or full -- s and m, the former names, read as short and medium until 2027-01-01; without it a field pairs with its neighbour from 44rem of the form's own width. A field of a type the field renderers do not draw is left out

groups.summary: The groups the fields' group keys name, in order: {key, label}. With two or more, each is a fieldset with its label as the legend, 24 apart over a line. A field without a group, or with a group not listed, stands in one group of its own after the listed ones

field-host.summary: The record host's half of the field renderers' host interface (1.7.0), a property only: getFieldOptionsPage, getFieldOptionSearch, setFieldOptionSearch and loadFieldOptions page and search a record, relation or user picker (template reference_picker); getFieldUploads, startFieldUpload and retryFieldUpload transfer a file (template upload: the upload area is drawn and says its own error); getFieldText and formatFieldValue are the host's words and formatting; renderField(field, value, host, {editing, size}) draws a type a component set draws (items, complex, ru.requisites). Each is called with the renderers' arguments and, last, the form's host for that field, whose setFieldValue writes into the form's value (a stored file the host was handed). The form keeps setFieldValue and setFieldError, so the values, their checks and the submit stay the form's. Without it a picker pages the field's own options and a file field keeps the chosen files in its value ({name, size, mime, file}: the File for the host to send with the values). Working name (name to confirm)

apply.summary: submit: the form is saved with its button -- «Сохранить» and «Отмена» under the fields, a required yes/no is a checkbox (C165 (4)), «Есть несохранённые изменения» under the buttons after a change. instant: every change acts at once -- no buttons, a change event per field, a required yes/no is a switch (a settings panel, a block's parameters). answer: a form a person answers once, a questionnaire in a message or a feed entry (owner decision C291 (3)) -- «Отправить» and «Отмена» under the fields; a press puts the answer on its way (state pending, «Отправляем…»), the host sets the outcome; accepted shows the values read-only with the mark «Отправлено» and no «Изменить», nothing reopens them; mode is not read

size.summary: The rung of the fields and the buttons on the size ladder: 1, or 1/2 for a form in a message (owner decision C291 (3)). The label, the hint and the error keep the 1/2 text step at both

state.summary: apply answer only: where the answer is, the confirm surface's words (sf-confirm). open: the fields and «Отправить», «Отмена». pending: an answer is on its way, set by a press -- the fields are locked, the pressed button waits, «Отправляем…» (or «Отменяем…»). accepted: the values sent, read-only, with «Отправлено». declined: nothing is drawn (C35: a declined answer says nothing). expired: only «Время ответа истекло». The host sets the outcome; back to open when the answer could not be delivered (with set-errors for the fields to fix)

labels.summary: top: the label above its field (the default). start: the label stands beside its field, the labels of a group in one column as wide as the longest label up to 40 % of the row and every field after it on one axis -- the row of a settings page and of an admin card, and a record's group edited in place (C401); it switches as sf-list-description's layout auto does (C180 (3)): beside from a form wider than 20rem, above in a narrower one and on a phone (below md). The value name top is a working name (name to confirm)

footer.summary: static: the buttons under the last field, the main one first at the start. sticky: the same buttons in a bar that sticks to the bottom of the scrolling place while the form is longer than it -- a settings page (C166 (3)). The value name static is a working name (name to confirm)

label.summary: The form's accessible name (the native form's aria-label), so a screen reader announces it as a form landmark; best the heading the form stands under. Working name (name to confirm)

origin.summary: Where the fields' values come from, the words every field with an origin says (FS-1, owner decision C422): own (the lead of an own value, «Своё для simai.ru»; «Своё значение» by default), above (the upper level before its value, «у всех сайтов»; «общее»), inherited (the quiet line of an inherited value, «Как у всех сайтов»; none by default, C422 marks only an own value and a locked one) and locked (the reason a field is closed above; «Закрыто на уровне выше»). A field's own origin words win. Working name (name to confirm)

guard.summary: The leave guard (FS-4, C166 (6), C422): while the form holds unsaved changes, closing or reloading the tab asks the browser's question, and a press on a link that leaves the page -- another page, or a route the page draws in place (an address in the page that names no element) -- is held: the cancelable leave event goes out, and the form asks «Уйти без сохранения?» in a question window with C159 (6)'s answers, «Не сохранять» (red, first; the fields go back and the link is pressed again) and «Продолжить правку» (quiet, with the focus; the page and the menu stay). A link inside the form, one that opens another tab or downloads, or a press with a modifier key passes. Working name (name to confirm)

readonly.summary: A form the person may read but not change (FS-5, C348, C422): the values as text, as mode view draws them, with no «Изменить» and no «Сохранить»; the reason line (readonly-reason) stands where the buttons would. Not read under apply answer

readonly-reason.summary: readonly: why the form cannot be changed, said where the buttons would stand («Менять настройки сайта может администратор сайта»); «Только чтение» by default. Working name (name to confirm)

value.summary: The values by field key: {text: "Подробнее", tone: "accent"}. Set from code it is the saved state: the form shows it, forgets the errors and is not dirty; read, it is what the fields hold now and what a save sends: a field its conditions hide (when.visible) is left out, while the form keeps what it held so that showing the field again brings it back (FO3-1, Larena settings standard §4). A value the person never set is absent

mode.summary: edit: the fields. view: the values as text (the field renderers' view, as a record card shows them) with «Изменить» under them; «Изменить» opens edit, and «Сохранить» or «Отмена» return to view. Working name (name to confirm)

valid.summary: True when every field it shows passes its check now (required, the control's own validity, an error the host set); read-only and silent -- reading it shows no error (§17.4)

dirty.summary: True when a value differs from the saved state (the last value set from code, or the last submit). Read-only; a host that closes a window asks «Закрыть без сохранения?» on it (C159 (6)). Working name (name to confirm)

busy.summary: While the host saves (FS-2, C159 (9)): «Сохранить» shows its loading in its own colour, «Отмена» waits, every field is read-only and a second press or Enter does nothing; the form is aria-busy. The host that cancels submit to save sets it and answers with the saved action, set-errors, a new value or busy false, each of which ends it

saved-at.summary: When the values were last saved, an ISO date and time (FS-3): the state line under the buttons says «Сохранено в 14:35» in the reader's clock until the next change, which empties it and says «Есть несохранённые изменения». Written by a submit not cancelled and by the saved action; a host may set it from code. Working name (name to confirm)

input.summary: A field's value changed by the person: its key and the new value (undefined when the field withdrew an incomplete text). Sent as sf-form-input, not input: the fields' own native input events bubble through the form unchanged

change.summary: apply instant only: a field's value is applied (§8, one per commit of the field): typed text when the control commits it (its change: leaving the field, Enter) or the person leaves the field, a choice, a box or a file at once; only a value that differs from the one last applied. Sent as sf-form-change, not change: the fields' own native change events bubble through the form unchanged

inherited.summary: FS-1: the keys whose value is the upper level's again (a field with origin.value equal to it), for a host that stores them as inherited rather than as an own value

submit.summary: apply submit: «Сохранить» (or Enter in a one-line field) found every field right; value is every shown field's value by key (a field its conditions hide is not sent, FO3-1). Not cancelled, the value becomes the saved state (dirty false) and a form that was opened from view returns to view; cancelled, the form stays as it is (the host answers later, with set-errors or a new value). Not cancelled, the state line says «Сохранено в HH:MM» (saved-at); a host that cancels it to save sets busy and answers with the saved action (FS-2, FS-3)

value.summary: With accepted true: every field's value by key, as submit carries it

answer.summary: apply answer: «Отправить» found every field right (accepted true, with the value) or «Отмена» was pressed (accepted false). Sent with state pending; the host sets the outcome, in its handler or later: accepted, declined, or open again. Cancelled, the answer was not taken: the form is open again and may be answered again (the confirm surface's answer)

invalid.summary: A submit or check-validity found wrong fields: their keys in order. Every one shows its error at the field; from two errors a summary with a link to each stands over the form and takes the focus. A host error (set-errors) for a field its conditions hide is said in the summary by the field's label, without a link, and does not hold the next submit back (FO3-1)

cancel.summary: «Отмена»: the fields went back to the saved state (value), the errors are gone; a form opened from view returns to view

reset-field.summary: «Вернуть общее» under a field with an own value (FS-1): the field's key and the upper level's value it takes. Not cancelled, the field takes it as the person's change -- dirty until «Сохранить», applied at once (change) in an instant form -- and the focus goes to the field; cancelled, nothing changes. Working name (name to confirm)

leave.summary: guard: a press on a link that leaves the page while the form holds unsaved changes (FS-4); href is where it goes. The press is held before anything else hears it. Not cancelled, the form asks «Уйти без сохранения?» and, after «Не сохранять», presses the link again; cancelled, the host takes it over (its own question, or the reset action and its own route). Working name (name to confirm)

check-validity.summary: Checks every field it shows and shows every error, as «Сохранить» does but without submit: applied when right, refused {reason: invalid} otherwise (§17.4). Moves no focus

reset.summary: Every field returns to the saved state, without events; the errors and the summary are gone (§17.4)

refresh-fields.summary: The field host's answers changed -- a page of candidates, an upload's progress, a stored file -- and the fields are drawn again with what it answers now (1.7.0). The form draws again by itself when a host call answers a promise that settles. Working name (name to confirm)

set-errors.summary: The host's answer to a submit: {key: message} -- each named field shows the message as its error until the person changes it, from two a summary takes the focus as after «Сохранить»; an empty object clears them. A form in view opens edit. refused {reason: missing} when no key names a field it shows. Working name (name to confirm)

saved.summary: The host's answer to a save it took over (it cancelled submit, FS-2, FS-3): the values the fields hold are the saved state -- dirty false, busy false, saved-at the given ISO time or now, «Сохранено в HH:MM» in the state line; a form opened from view returns to view. refused {reason: mode} in view, under apply instant or answer

confirm-leave.summary: A host's own route asks before it leaves (FS-4): applied at once when the form has no unsaved changes, else after «Уйти без сохранения?» -- applied with «Не сохранять» (the fields are back to the saved state), refused {reason: stayed} with «Продолжить правку». Working name (name to confirm)

relations.name: cl-modal
$comment: The leave question (FS-4): an sf-modal size question with its two answers, fetched when the question opens (GB18 L3: not on the form's first paint).

relations.name: modal
$comment: holdFieldsReadOnly from component/modal/js/_focus.js (bundled into the form's script): the fields are held while a save runs (FS-2, C159 (9)); the window's sheets are not on the form's first paint (GB18 L3).

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16): the build does not compile template.html yet, so a second copy of the markup would only drift from the one that draws.

skeleton.$comment: The fields and their groups arrive after the first paint when the host builds the form from a schema it loads: the derived skeleton (static/default/<example>.skeleton.html) holds their box until they do, as for the eight lists (standard 1.3.8 §5.4; FP-8 of the first-paint status R222).

accessibility.$comment: A native form (role form when label names it; novalidate, the form says the errors in its own words). Each field is a label row over the control the field renderers draw; the control is named by the label (its aria-label) and a required one carries the native required, so the «*» is hidden from a screen reader. Groups are fieldsets named by their legend. The errors summary is role alert with tabindex -1: after «Сохранить» with two errors or more it takes the focus and its links each move the focus to their field. The unsaved note is a polite status.

x-summary: A form drawn from field descriptions: the label row, «*», «?», hint and error around each control the Framework's field renderers draw, groups, one column that pairs fields from 44rem, an errors summary with links from two errors, the buttons under the fields with the main one first, a view mode with «Изменить», and apply submit, instant or answer (a questionnaire answered once, read-only with «Отправлено» after it) in one component.

x-source.brief: Owner decision C182 (2026-11-14), all nine by the recommendation of the form study (control/research/2026-11-14-form.md, prototype prototypes/form-study.html): (1) a Framework Smart component over field-renderers; (2) the name sf-form (C174); (3) the descriptor is the Framework field descriptor sf-view-properties sends; (4) one column, short fields pair from 44rem of its own width (width s 8rem / m 16rem / full); (5) the label above, labels="start" beside from 40rem; (6) errors at the fields and a summary with links from two errors, the focus to it; (7) the buttons under the fields, the main first at the start, «Сохранить» never disabled, «Есть несохранённые изменения» under them, footer="sticky" for settings pages; (8) view mode is the values as text with «Изменить»; (9) one component, apply="instant|submit"

x-decisions: name: sf-form, family form (owner decision C182 (2), naming C174: the family first). The settings apply (submit, instant), labels (start) and footer (sticky) and the field descriptor's width s, m, full are the decision's names. Working names, not given by the decision, to confirm with the owner: labels top, footer static, the settings fields, groups and label (fields and groups are the prototype's form.fields and form.groups), the values mode (edit, view) and dirty, the action set-errors and the event cancel.

descriptor (C182 (3)): the Framework field descriptor sf-view-properties sends -- the property registry's type and parameters plus key, label, hint, help, width and group -- drawn by the field renderers this bundle carries (src/smart/field-renderers, renderEditField and renderViewField; importing them also publishes SF.fieldRenderers). The form draws only the frame: the label row (label, «*», «?» as sf-help-mark), the hint, the error, the groups, the layout and the buttons. A required yes/no is a checkbox under apply submit and a switch under apply instant (field-renderers 1.12.0, C165 (4)); a checkbox carries its label itself, beside the box. A JSON Schema reader is a later helper (C182 (3)).

layout (C182 (4)): one column; from 44rem of the form's own width (a container query on its root) the fields without width pair in two columns, 32 apart (--sf-space-2); short, medium and full fields take a row of their own, short and medium with the control at most the field width steps --sf-field--width-short and -medium wide (8rem and 16rem as s and m before 1.13.0); the group's legend spans the row. Narrower everything is one column.

labels (C182 (5), C153 (1), (2)): the label above its field, 14 on its line (--sf-text-size-1/2) in the text colour, 14 on a phone too, 4 over the control (--sf-space-1/4); «*» after a required field's label in the label's colour, hidden from a screen reader (the control is required), and «* — обязательные поля» over a form that has one; help is an sf-help-mark after the label. labels="start" from 40rem: the label in the first third, the control, the hint and the error in the rest, 32 apart, the label on the control's line.

errors (C182 (6), C153 (3), C55): a field shows its error under itself after a submit, after the person left a field they changed, and loses it the moment the value is right. The words are the form's, naming the field («Заполните поле «Текст»») for a missing value, the control's own for any other failure, or the host's (set-errors, a field renderer's setFieldError). A control of the field family (sf-input and its kin, sf-dropdown) is given invalid and error-message and says it in its own message line, linked to its native control; for any other control the form draws the line under it. The error takes the hint's place. From two errors after a submit a summary stands over the form: the quiet error container, «Исправьте N поля» and a link per error; it is role alert, takes the focus, and each link moves the focus to its field. One error: the focus goes to that field.

footer (C182 (7), C159 (4), C157 (3), C105 H5): the buttons under the last field, 24 under it (--sf-space-3), «Сохранить» first at the start and «Отмена» after it, --sf-space-1/3 apart (8; 4 compact). «Сохранить» is never disabled. After the first change a polite status «Есть несохранённые изменения» stands under the buttons, 8 under them. footer="sticky" keeps them in a bar at the bottom of the scrolling place, on the place's solid surface over a line.

view (C182 (8)): mode view draws every value as text with renderViewField, the label row above it, and «Изменить» (an outline button) under them; disabled fields are not used for read-only. «Изменить» opens edit with the focus on the first field; «Сохранить» (not cancelled) and «Отмена» return to view with the focus on «Изменить».
apply (C182 (9)): one component. submit -- a native form (novalidate), Enter in a one-line field submits it; instant -- no buttons and no required note, change {key, value} per field.

spacing (C52, C105, C144): between fields --sf-space-1, between groups and before the buttons --sf-space-3, the group line on the outline-variant role, label to control --sf-space-1/4; values only from the space system.

version 1.1.0 (2026-11-15, owner decision C165 (1), (3); research ui-control control/research/2026-11-14-checks.md, prototype prototypes/checks-study.html): a minor. A short choice field -- an editable choice or choices of at most five options without variant buttons, select or checklist (js/choice-list.js LIST_MOST) -- is drawn through sf-input-choice appearance="list" (sf-input-choice 1.5.0): a column of radios for a choice of one, of checks for a choice of several, up to three short options in a row (flow auto). Before, both were a dropdown. The form keeps its label row (label, «*», «?») and its hint; the group is named by the label and says its error under its last row. The value is written back in the option's own type, the list in the options' order. A longer list, a read-only field and a field that names its own variant are drawn as before.

version 1.2.0 (2026-11-16, first paint R222 FP-8; numbered above 1.1.0 on origin/main): a minor. The late data settings fields and groups are declared in presentation.skeleton.late, as the other list components declare theirs: a page that sets them after the first paint gets the late skeleton (sfLateHeld) instead of an empty box, and the first-paint skeleton snapshots are printed for them.

version 1.2.1 (2026-11-16, DEV follow-up msg-a1474963 to C182; numbered above 1.2.0 on origin/fix/first-paint-fp1): a patch. The hint the form draws under a field, and the error line it draws for a control that does not say its own, are read with the field: their ids join the aria-describedby of the control's native focus target (a group of choices as a whole), after the form's drawing and after the control's own, and leave it once the line is gone; ids the control set itself are kept. A screen reader heard the label and the value and never the hint. Markup, look, settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.3.1 (2026-11-17, feat/lang-file-c282; numbered above 1.3.0 on origin/fix/layer-order-c273): a patch. Russian is a language file (owner decision C282, 2026-11-17): the bundle carries the English words only (lang/index.mjs, written by scripts/build-language-packs.mjs from src/core/lang/built-in.json); the Russian ones come from core/lang/ru.js included before core, or from the ru part of its family that core fetches, and SF.Loader holds the definition until that part is here (at most 800 ms). A page with the language file draws the same Russian as before; lang/ru.json is unchanged.

version 1.3.2 (written on the branch as 1.2.2; 2026-11-17, owner decision C268; numbered above 1.2.1 on origin/fix/fields-files-e1): a patch, nothing to see. The template writes pointer-events-none, the class named as the property, for pointer-event-none, its former name until 2027-01-01 (journal class-c268-pointer-events), so a page of the component no longer notes a deprecation. Settings, values, events, keys and drawing unchanged.

version 1.3.3 (written on the branch as 1.3.0; 2026-11-17): a minor (owner decision C273, utility or component). The component's fill, edge colour, text colour and the place roles it declares stand in the new cascade layer sf.paint, under the utilities, so a bg-*, border-* or color-* class on it or on one of its parts now paints it; its size, padding, radius, height and edge width stay in sf.components, over the utilities. The look without a utility is unchanged (the built sheets hold the same declarations, the paint ones in sf.paint). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.3.4 (2026-11-17, set boundary study msg-e78f2e51): a patch. A field of a property type the field renderers do not draw at all (money or percent, which a component set draws, or a misspelt type) is still left out, and the form now says so once per type on the page: one console warning naming the field and the type, where it was dropped without a word. Settings, values and events unchanged.

version 1.4.0 (2026-11-17, owner decision C291 (3), FO-8): a minor, settings added. apply answer: a form a person answers once, the questionnaire in a message the View set drew as sf-view-flow -- «Отправить» and «Отмена» under the fields, the answer event (accepted, value; cancelable), the setting state with the confirm surface's words (open, pending, accepted, declined, expired) and its glyphs and lines («Отправляем…», «Отправлено», «Время ответа истекло»), a read view after the answer with the mark «Отправлено» and no «Изменить». size 1/2: the fields and the buttons a rung down for a message. Host state data-state. Fields of the property types money and percent are drawn now (module.smart-field-renderers 1.15.0, C291 (2)). apply submit and instant at size 1: unchanged.

version 1.5.0 (2026-11-18, feat/type-templates; numbered above 1.4.0, the highest on any origin branch): a minor. The field descriptor declares what the field renderers read since C302, C303 and C294: template and templateParams (variant is read as template until 2027-01-01, with one console warning from the renderers), decimals (a number's digits after the point, fixed when the field is created; 0 is a whole number), and a money field's currency, currencies and currencyDisplay (the C294 follow-up: the form passed them through without declaring them). A field of type integer is drawn as a number with decimals 0, phone and password are types of their own.

version 1.6.0 (2026-11-18, field orders FO-1 and FO-6 of the ui-view property pages, view round 2; numbered above 1.5.0, the highest on any origin branch): a minor. FO-6: the field descriptor declares holder, the ru.inn field's holder fixed when the field is created -- any (10 or 12 digits, the default), organization (10) or person (12) -- which the field renderers read since step 3 of the type-template catalogue and the form passed through undeclared. FO-1: sf-switch, sf-checkbox (a yes/no), sf-segmented (the «Да» | «Нет» buttons) and sf-file-upload say their error themselves now (invalid and error-message, SPEAKING_TAGS): the form gives them the two attributes and draws no error line of its own under them, so a yes/no or a file field shows its error as every other field does. FL-7 of the property page study: the field descriptor declares defaultCountry too (the phone field's starting country, which the field renderers read since 1.18.0). The control a field's error is told to is its first speaking control (a file field's upload area, not the preview of a file it holds). One option of a checklist (a long choices field drawn as boxes) is not that control: the form keeps its line under the list, and no longer writes the field's label on the first option's box.

version 1.7.0 (2026-11-18, record card order FO-C305-1 of the ui-view property pages, view round 2; numbered above 1.6.0, the highest on any origin branch): a minor. The record card's group edit can be sf-form for every group: the setting field-host takes the half of the field renderers' host interface the record keeps -- the reference picker's pages and search (record, relation and user, template reference_picker), the transfer of a file (template upload: the upload area is drawn and says its own error, FO-1), the host's words and formatting, and renderField for the types a component set draws (items, complex, ru.requisites; the registry's set) -- each called with the renderers' arguments and the form's host for the field last. The form keeps setFieldValue and setFieldError: the values, the checks (required on a picker, a file, a set's rows) and the submit's value stay the form's, in the shapes the type-template registry gives (a picked record {value, label}, a file the host's stored shape, rows a list). Without a field host a picker pages the field's own options and a file field keeps the chosen files in its value ({name, size, mime, file}); a picker nobody pages shows its value read-only instead of nothing. The action refresh-fields draws the fields again when the host's answers change.

version 1.10.0 (written on the branch as 1.4.0; 2026-11-17, Framework order FO-3 of the view set study, ui-control control/research/2026-11-17-view-round-1/framework-orders.md): a minor. A field's conditions are part of the Framework field descriptor: when {visible?, required?, enabled?}, each a condition over the other fields' values on screen in the grammar {field, op, value} with op eq, ne, in, not_in, empty, not_empty, and {all: []}, {any: []}, {not: {}} (field-renderers/conditions.js, SF.fieldRenderers.conditions). The form evaluates them on every drawing: a field shows the moment the value it waits for is chosen, becomes required (its «*», its check) and enabled (drawn read-only while not); a hidden field keeps its value and is not checked, and an error of a field that another value hid or made optional goes. A condition that cannot be read leaves the field as declared. Additions only: fields without when draw as 1.3.3 did.

forbidden_client_responsibilities: saving the values (the host hears submit or change and saves them)
checking a value against the server's rules (the host answers with set-errors)
deciding who may change a field (the host sends readonly)

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-form for a form drawn from a list of field descriptions: a record's edit, a settings page, a block's parameters (apply instant), a sign-up or a request on a site.
do_not: Do not draw the label, the «*», the hint or the error beside a field by hand; give them in the descriptor
Do not disable «Сохранить» until the form is right; the form says what is wrong
Do not show read-only values as disabled fields; use mode view
Do not put two columns by hand; the form pairs fields from 44rem of its own width

keyboard: Tab walks the fields in order, then «Сохранить» and «Отмена» (or «Изменить» in view)
Enter in a one-line field submits the form
After a submit with two errors or more the focus is on the summary; Tab reaches its links, and Enter on a link moves the focus to that field
accessibility.focus: A submit with one error moves the focus to that field, with two or more to the summary. «Изменить» moves it to the first field; returning to view moves it to «Изменить».
